title: cyathea ursina
intro: Cyathea ursina, commonly known as the Lion's Spine Fern, is a species of fern in the Cyatheaceae family. It is native to Australia, where it is found in tropical and subtropical regions. The health benefits of Cyathea ursina include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health issues such as arthritis and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cyathea ursina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and anti-cancer properties.
